description: Square-wave d-axis excitation along +/-paired electrical angles at standstill, (i_d, i_q) in the excitation frame recorded on-device per control tick. The i_q transient is a null channel: it exists only if Ld != Lq. tools/saliency.py fits the ratio and gives the zero-speed-sensorless verdict.
title: Saliency (Ld/Lq) sweep
